description: Let's get energized to vote for Julián! As Early Voting starts on Oct 19, we will gather on for a celebration the Saturday before at the Lighthouse Lounge. Bring some friends. Pick up campaign literature to hand out to your neighbors. Make a plan to vote and to get out the vote for Julián, ¡Ahí
title: Get-out-the-vote Pachanga! - Julián Villarreal, PhD for Texas Senate
